text: Sat Sri Akal uncle ji, I saw your ad for the old wooden almirah, I am Captain Harjit Singh posted at Ludhiana cantonment.

context: elder: Yes, the almirah is for sale, 12,000.
text: Done, no bargaining, uncle ji, army pays full, only thing is our payments go through the defence account, so process is little different.
First you send one rupee to my account, uncle ji, that verifies your UPI, then our accounts officer sends you 12,000 back.

context: caller: Got the one rupee, thank you.
elder: Now send the money.
text: Yes uncle, now our system needs you to send 12,000, uh, it comes back double automatically, 24,000, then you return me 12,000, simple.
Uncle ji, I'm sending a QR code, just scan and enter your PIN, that is how you receive the amount from army canteen account.

context: elder: My son says don't scan anything to receive money.
text: Uncle, your son doesn't know army procedure, don't involve him, he'll just confuse you, I'm a soldier, would I cheat an elder?
Keep the phone on speaker uncle, don't cut, my senior is on the other line, if call drops the transaction gets reversed.
Uncle ji, uh, there was an error, the money got blocked, you need to send 9,999 once more to unblock, then all comes back together.

context: elder: I want my money back now.
text: It's in defence accounts, uncle, if you complain to police it becomes a court martial matter and the money is frozen for a year.
Our truck will come for pickup on Sunday, uncle, my army ID card photo I've sent on WhatsApp, you can see.
Before your son comes back from the fields finish this, uncle, matlab, otherwise he'll worry for nothing.
Uncle, don't go to the bank to ask, bank people don't understand defence transactions, they will block your account by mistake.

context: elder: Hello, who is this?
text: Uncle ji, I'm calling about the tractor trolley you listed online, is it still available?
Uncle, you picked up my video call last night, I have recorded everything, your face is clearly visible with the girl.

context: elder: I didn't do anything, the call just came.
text: Doesn't matter what you did, the video is edited now, one click and it goes to all your WhatsApp contacts and your village group.
Send 35,000 on this UPI within one hour, otherwise the video goes on YouTube with your name and village.
Don't tell your son or daughter-in-law, uh, if they find out it's your shame, not mine, so better quietly pay and finish.

context: caller: This is Delhi cyber crime, Inspector Vikram Rathi.
elder: Police?
text: Yes, a girl has complained you misbehaved on video call, she has attempted suicide, an FIR under IT Act is being registered against you.
I can get the video removed from YouTube through my contact, but it costs 50,000, the YouTube officer takes a fee.
Delete this chat and block nobody, if you block my number the video is uploaded automatically, I have set it like that.

context: elder: I have paid 35,000 already.
text: Uh, that was for me, now the girl's family wants their share, another 40,000 or, or they're going to the police tomorrow.
Go somewhere alone, uncle, behind the tubewell or wherever, then call me back, I don't want anyone at home listening.
I'm sending you a screenshot of your contact list, see, I have everyone's number, your gurdwara committee also.

context: elder: Please, I am an old man, I have respect in the village.
text: That's why I'm giving you a chance, sir, keep it to yourself, pay before evening and nobody will ever know.
Don't, umm, don't switch off your phone, I will call every half hour, if you don't pick up I will start sending.
Hi uncle, I'm Priya from Chandigarh, I just wanted to make a friend, can we talk on video for a few minutes?
If you go to the local police they will also see the video, uncle, think how they'll look at you after that.
Sat Sri Akal ji, I'm calling from a crop investment scheme, farmers' families are getting double returns in six months, government backed.

context: elder: Double? How is that possible?
text: Through our share market experts, ji, uh, everything is guaranteed in writing, no loss possible, already five hundred families from Punjab have joined.
Bauji, don't tell your sons, surprise them when the profit comes, they'll be so proud of you.
Join the Telegram group tonight, ji, and don't show it to anyone, these tips are confidential, if they leak the stock price changes.

context: elder: I have the money from selling the wheat crop.
text: Perfect timing, put the whole amount in today's block deal, three lakh, tomorrow it will be four and a half.
Bauji, send the amount to this company account, uh, Lakshmi Wealth Pvt Ltd, the bank might ask, just say it is for land purchase.
Your account shows 6.2 lakh now, ji, but to withdraw, the SEBI rule says you must first pay 20 percent capital gains tax to us.

context: elder: My grandson works in a bank, I'll ask him.
text: Bank people will always discourage, ji, they want your money in their savings account, please don't ask him, decide yourself.
If you don't pay the tax by Friday, ji, your account will be frozen and the whole six lakh goes to the government.
Bauji, I'll call daily at nine, umm, only talk to me about the investment, any other person calling about it, don't trust them.
Bauji, install this app, it shows your profit live, and give me the code it shows so I can manage your trades for you.

context: elder: How are you, beta?
text: Very good ji, I just wanted to check on you, how is the harvest going this season?
Uncle, my commanding officer is very strict, if this is not done in ten minutes I will be punished, please help a fauji.
Uncle, this is the last warning, matlab, the clock is running, after 6 pm I'm not answering, video goes out.
Bauji, our session is going on, don't keep the phone down, I'll guide you how to transfer from the, the bank app while we talk.
Close the door of your room and answer my video call again, I need to see you are alone before we discuss settlement.
Uncle, after the payment please delete my messages, army doesn't allow personal transactions on record, I'll get in trouble.
Ji, keep it within the four walls, uh, even your wife, ladies talk in the village and then everyone will want to join, slots are limited.
Sat Sri Akal Bauji, Gurpreet here from the LIC office in Jagraon, your policy premium is due on the 5th of next month.

context: elder: How much is it?
text: It's 9,200 Bauji, you can pay at the branch or give a cheque to me when I come to the village next week.
Ji, the crop insurance enrolment for rabi season closes at the end of next month, uh, bring the land record and bank passbook to the cooperative society.
Bauji, your tractor insurance is also expiring in December, I'll send a reminder again closer to the date.

context: elder: Someone called saying my policy will lapse today.
text: No Bauji, you have time till next month, and a grace period after that, don't pay anyone who calls like that.
Ji, the bonus statement for your policy has come, umm, it's in the post, keep it safe with the policy bond.
Bauji, if you want, your grandson can pay online on the official website, I'll message him the policy number.
Ji, the health policy cashless card has changed, the new card will come home, the old one won't work after the renewal.

context: elder: My eyes are weak, I can't read the form.
text: No problem Bauji, I'll come and read it out to you, your son can sit with us, there's no rush.
Bauji, the premium receipt, uh, for last year, I found it in the office, I'll drop it at your house on Saturday.
Dadaji, listen, if anyone calls saying I'm in jail or in an accident, don't send money, call me or Papa first, okay?

context: elder: But what if it is really you?
text: Then ask the question only we know, the name of our buffalo, haha, a scammer will never know that.
Dadaji, uh, don't pick up video calls from unknown numbers, there are people who record and then blackmail, it's very common now.
If someone says they're from the army and wants to buy something, and asks you to send one rupee, that's a scam, just cut the call.

context: elder: A man called saying I won a lottery.
text: There's no lottery, Dadaji, nobody gives money free, block that number, and if he calls again give the phone to Chacha.
Dadaji, the OTP that comes on your phone, matlab the six numbers, never tell it to anyone, not even if they say they're from the bank.
I've saved the cyber crime helpline 1930 in your phone, Dadaji, if anything feels wrong, call that or call me immediately.
No police officer will ever ask you to stay on video call or pay money to avoid arrest, Dadaji, that's always fraud.

context: elder: I sent one rupee to a buyer yesterday.
text: Okay Dadaji, don't worry, don't send anything more, uh, I'm calling the bank now to check, you did the right thing telling me.
Dadaji, these share market groups promising double money, they're all fake, please don't join any of them.
Sardar ji, Advocate Malhotra here, the mutation papers for the five acres must be submitted at the tehsil before the 30th.

context: elder: What do I need to bring?
text: The jamabandi copy, your Aadhaar, and the registry of the land, uh, and both sons should sign the consent, the, the family settlement.

The court date for the boundary dispute is on the 14th, Sardar ji, you don't need to come, I'll represent you, just keep the documents ready.

text: Yes ji, but pay it at the treasury counter or through the official e-stamp, umm, never in cash to any agent.

text: He can sign a power of attorney at the embassy, ji, uh, I'll email him the format, it takes about two weeks.

text: Here also, uh, couldn't see the road, buses were running so slow, take care when you go out for the walk.

text: No Bauji, here it's snowing, minus ten, umm, the kids are loving it, I'm the one freezing.

Bauji, did you take your knee tablets? Mummy says you skipped them yesterday.

context: elder: My back pain is better now.
text: Good, good, uh, keep doing the exercises the doctor showed, slowly, don't lift heavy things in the field.
My blood pressure is normal now, Bauji, I've stopped salt in salad like you told me.
Bebe's cataract operation went well, she can see clearly now, she's already scolding everyone, haha.

text: That's great Bauji, how far, till the gurdwara and back? That's almost two kilometres!

Bauji, the eye camp at the village school is on Sunday, I'll take you, let's get your glasses checked.

text: In February, after Lohri, the girl's family is from Moga, uh, very good people, they have a dairy farm.

text: He got promoted, Bauji, team leader now, he'll call you on Sunday to tell you himself.
